content: SaaS account-settings UX convention: keep the account/profile page light with only mission-critical actions surfaced directly (edit profile, billing/subscription status, security) and no more than one click away; push secondary settings deeper into sub-menus. Billing is typically its own section/tab showing plan, payment method, and invoice history rather than being embedded inline in the profile form. Distinguish a lightweight 'Account' summary view from a deeper 'Account Settings' configuration page.
